info.title: extractpo
info.description: .NET Core global tool for extracting translatable strings from the OrchardCore source files.

options.name: --language
options.description: Specifies the code language to extracts translatable strings from. [default: C#]

options.name: --template
options.description: Specifies the template engine to extract the translatable strings from.

options.name: --ignore
options.description: Ignores extracting PO files from a given project(s).

options.name: --localizer
options.description: Specifies the name of the localizer(s) that will be used during the extraction process.

options.name: --plugin
options.description: A path or web URL with HTTPS scheme to a C# script (.csx) file which can define further IProjectProcessor implementations. You can have multiple of this switch in a call.

arguments.name: INPUT PATH
arguments.description: The path to the input directory, all projects at the the path will be processed.

arguments.name: OUTPUT PATH
arguments.description: The path to a directory where POT files will be generated.
